name: The Evil Magician
source:
Children are disappearing across the land—kidnapped by an evil magician of great legend and infamy! What is his nefarious reason for snatching the children? Can anyone save them? Their best hope lies in Percy, a fledgling magician, and Millicent, his bunny companion.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27679]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
孩子们在各地消失——被一名传说中臭名昭著的邪恶魔法师绑架！他绑架孩子的邪恶目的是什么？有人能救出他们吗？他们最大的希望是初出茅庐的魔法师珀西，以及他的兔子伙伴米莉森特。

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27679]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
